explanation.headline: Tobramycin is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale General holds 15.6 days on hand for the 4 mL presentation and 18.3 days for the 5 mL presentation

sentences.text: FDA's records show tobramycin is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 539 eachs of the 300 mg/4 mL presentation at 15.4 per day for 35 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 257 eachs of the same 4 mL presentation at 16.5 per day for 15.6 days on hand.
Corvale East holds 354 eachs of the 300 mg/5 mL presentation at 14.4 per day for 24.5 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 293 eachs of the 5 mL presentation at 16 per day for 18.3 days on hand.
The top-ranked option by rule is to buy from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
